title: Money Tree
wikitext:
{{Tree Infobox |title = Money Tree |image = Money Bag Stage 5 Fruit |Sapling = Tree Coin |Produce = Money Bag |Growth Time = 28 days |Season = {{Season|All}} |Sell Price = 10000 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Trees|Fruit Tree]]. It takes 28 days to grow to maturity, after which it will produce [[Money Bag]] each day during all seasons. It can only grow in the center of a 3x3 square, each square of which must be kept completely clear of objects, flooring, and terrain features (including grass). The 3x3 grid must not overlap the 3x3 grid of another Fruit Tree. For each full year after maturing, fruit trees will produce higher quality fruit, up to iridium star quality after three years. Note that the 3x3 square around the tree doesn't have to be kept clear once the tree has fully grown. If struck by lightning during a [[Stardew:Weather#Storm|thunderstorm]], a fruit tree will produce [[Stardew:Coal|Coal]] for 4 days instead of fruit. Fruit trees can be planted in the [[Stardew:Greenhouse|Greenhouse]]. [[Tree Coin|Tree Coins]] cannot be purchased; they can be obtained by chopping down existing Money Trees in [[The Highlands]] and are a rare drop from digging up [[Stardew:Artifact Spots|Artifact Spots]]. ==Stages==
